method: 3D SIMP topology optimization (parts/picogk-catalog/bionic/topopt.py), then PicoGK smoothing and exact functional features
basis_note: Nothing of this part is measured: length, section, clips and screws are the F0 hypotheses of source/picogk.json. The visible shell (crown, draft, end ramps, rounded edges, snap tongues with hook lips) is kept exact by the keep-in from source/bionic_keepins.py; only the support structure inside, above the assumed 20 mm rail clearance, is optimized. The step loads are assumptions (no screening load exists for this part). A load-path concept, to be recomputed once the rail and the fixings are measured.
